sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana for the Economically Backward Classes (PMSSEBC) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing financial security to economically weaker sections of society.
The primary objective of the scheme is to offer affordable insurance coverage to individuals from economically backward classes.
The scheme provides a life insurance cover of a specified amount to the insured individual in case of death due to any reason.
Eligibility for the scheme includes individuals belonging to the economically backward classes as defined by the government.
Applicants must be between the ages of 18 and 70 years to enroll in the scheme.
The application process typically involves filling out a form and providing necessary documentation to prove eligibility.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Finance through various insurance companies.
The coverage under the scheme is available on an annual basis and requires renewal each year.
Additional details regarding the premium amount and specific coverage limits may vary based on the insurance provider.
